name: elevenlabs-toolkit
description: ElevenLabs API toolkit: speech-to-text transcription (Scribe v2) with Python CLI and skill-driven workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Speech-to-text transcription via ElevenLabs Scribe v2
interface.longDescription: ElevenLabs developer skill package. Currently provides batch speech-to-text transcription using Scribe v2 (90+ languages, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, SRT subtitle output). The skill auto-detects existing transcribe.py in the project, performs a pre-flight length check (ffprobe), offers sample testing on long audio (default 2-minute clip), and saves date-stamped transcripts next to the input file.
